name: @saasreport/workbench
description: The workbench archetype (after the Gloomberb pattern, built natively): a command grammar with a schema-validated registry, a Persian-folded command line, keyboard navigation, a pane layout manager, watchlists, and panes that each declare their data through a SourceEnvelope and always show a SYNTHETIC / SANDBOX / YOURS / PUBLIC FEED badge. No content of its own: every command, pane and source comes from the project's widgets.spec.json.
